name: ai-coding-bootcamp-specs
description: Spec-driven course materials and Slidev generation pipeline for an enterprise AI-assisted coding bootcamp.

scripts.slides: npm run generate && slidev build/slides/ai-coding-bootcamp.slidev.md --remote course-preview --bind 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3030}
scripts.build: npm run generate && slidev build build/slides/ai-coding-bootcamp.slidev.md --out $PWD/dist/slides --router-mode hash
scripts.export:pptx: npm run generate && node scripts/ensure-export-deps.mjs && slidev export build/slides/ai-coding-bootcamp.slidev.md --format pptx --output $PWD/dist/ai-coding-bootcamp.pptx --timeout 120000
scripts.export:pdf: npm run generate && node scripts/ensure-export-deps.mjs && slidev export build/slides/ai-coding-bootcamp.slidev.md --format pdf --output $PWD/dist/ai-coding-bootcamp.pdf --timeout 120000
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run generate && npm run build
